/* De banner komt binnen en blijft daarna subtiel bewegen */
.uaf-international-warning {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            120deg,
            #fff6f6 0%,
            #ffffff 35%,
            #fff5f5 50%,
            #ffffff 65%,
            #fff6f6 100%
        );

    background-size: 220% 220%;

    border: 2px solid #a40e0e;
    border-left: 9px solid #a40e0e;
    border-radius: 14px;

    padding: 22px 24px !important;
    margin: 16px 0;

    color: #a40e0e;
    box-sizing: border-box;

    animation:
        uafWarningEnter 0.55s ease-out both,
        uafBackgroundMove 7s ease-in-out 0.55s infinite,
        uafBorderBreath 3s ease-in-out 0.55s infinite;
}


/* =========================
   Bewegend licht
   ========================= */

.uaf-international-warning::after {
    content: "";

    position: absolute;
    top: -40%;
    left: -35%;

    width: 22%;
    height: 180%;

    background: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        transparent,
        rgba(164, 14, 14, 0.05),
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55),
        rgba(164, 14, 14, 0.05),
        transparent
    );

    transform: rotate(15deg);
    pointer-events: none;

    animation: uafLightSweep 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}


/* =========================
   Uitroepteken
   ========================= */

.uaf-international-warning .uaf-warning-icon {
    flex: 0 0 44px;

    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    background: #a40e0e;
    color: #ffffff;

    border-radius: 50%;

    font-size: 23px;
    font-weight: 700;

    animation: uafWarningPulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}


/* =========================
   Animaties
   ========================= */

/* Eerste keer rustig in beeld */
@keyframes uafWarningEnter {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(14px);
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}


/* Achtergrond beweegt continu */
@keyframes uafBackgroundMove {
    0% {
        background-position: 0% 50%;
    }

    50% {
        background-position: 100% 50%;
    }

    100% {
        background-position: 0% 50%;
    }
}


/* Kader krijgt continu een subtiele gloed */
@keyframes uafBorderBreath {
    0%,
    100% {
        box-shadow:
            0 6px 20px rgba(164, 14, 14, 0.08),
            0 0 0 rgba(164, 14, 14, 0);
    }

    50% {
        box-shadow:
            0 8px 26px rgba(164, 14, 14, 0.14),
            0 0 12px rgba(164, 14, 14, 0.10);
    }
}


/* Uitroepteken blijft pulseren */
@keyframes uafWarningPulse {
    0%,
    100% {
        transform: scale(1);
        box-shadow:
            0 0 0 0 rgba(164, 14, 14, 0.18);
    }

    50% {
        transform: scale(1.07);
        box-shadow:
            0 0 0 9px rgba(164, 14, 14, 0.06);
    }
}


/* Licht beweegt telkens door de banner */
@keyframes uafLightSweep {
    0% {
        left: -35%;
        opacity: 0;
    }

    15% {
        opacity: 1;
    }

    60% {
        opacity: 1;
    }

    75% {
        left: 125%;
        opacity: 0;
    }

    100% {
        left: 125%;
        opacity: 0;
    }
}


/* Voor mensen die beweging hebben uitgeschakeld */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .uaf-international-warning,
    .uaf-international-warning::after,
    .uaf-international-warning .uaf-warning-icon {
        animation: none;
    }
}
</style>

									<p class="gt-block"><span class="TextRun SCXW1348748 BCX0" lang="NL-NL" xml:lang="NL-NL" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW1348748 BCX0">Want to study in the Netherlands? Then you need a preparatory education. The required preparatory education depends on the program you want to pursue. Want to learn more about the Dutch education system?</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW1348748 BCX0"> Then check out this </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW1348748 BCX0">video.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW1348748 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>								</div>

					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">What is your foreign diploma or education worth in the Netherlands? </h2>				</div>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4cdc1a1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="4cdc1a1" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p class="gt-block MsoNormal">An international diploma evaluation makes it clear what your diploma is worth in the Netherlands. Do you have a residence permit and have you received the letter 'Notice of integration obligation'? Then you can <a href="https://www.idw.nl/inburgering/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">request a free credential evaluation from IDW</a>. The credential evaluation can help you find a job or further education. A credential evaluation is an advice. You cannot derive any rights from it. </p><p> </p><p class="MsoNormal">Are you still in the Internationale Schakelklas (ISK)? Then you can request a free training evaluation through the school.  </p>								</div>

												<a class="elementor-accordion-title" tabindex="0">I am under 18 years old. I want to follow an MBO course, but I do not have enough prior education. </a>
					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-7442" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="2" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-7442"><p class="gt-block"><strong>From International Bridging Class (ISK) to MBO levels 2, 3 and 4   </strong></p><p>Did you come to the Netherlands when you were 16 or 17? Then you were often unable to complete high school. As a young asylum seeker you will then enter an Internationale Schakelklas (ISK). In the bridging class you learn the Dutch language and integration. You are sometimes placed in an entrance course. This is equivalent to MBO level 1. For MBO level 2, 3 or 4 you usually need a diploma. </p><p>Are you placed in an entrance course, but do you still want to start with MBO 2, 3 or 4? Then you can have your level of education assessed. </p><p class="gt-block"><strong>Appreciate level of education </strong></p><p>This can help you learn at your level. Is your level of education comparable to a Dutch VMBO diploma or at least 3 years of HAVO or VWO? You can then enter at MBO level 2, 3 or 4. You must read, speak and write Dutch at minimum language level B1. You must also meet the other admission requirements for the course. Are you still in the ISK? You can then request a free training evaluation through the school. The school can do this through the Collaboration Organization for Vocational Education and Business (SBB).  </p><p class="gt-block"><strong>Were you unable to bring proof of your previous education?  </strong></p><p>Have you lost your diploma or grade lists and can you no longer retrieve them (safely)? Your school can then apply for an Education Level Indication (ION) for you. </p><p>Based on your information, the ION estimates your education level. The ROC will then decide at which level you can start. </p><p class="gt-block"><strong>Other possibilities  </strong></p><p>Are you not admitted to MBO level 2, 3 or 4 because your education level is too low? There are still options to achieve your goal. These also apply to people who are 18 years or older. Read more below.</p></div>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-7443" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="3" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-7443"><p class="gt-block">There are several ways to pursue higher education. You can do this step by step with the standard programs. For example, you can start with an entry-level program and continue studying until MBO level 4. For example: <span class="TrackChangeTextInsertion TrackedChange SCXW92098321 BCX0"><span class="TextRun SCXW92098321 BCX0" lang="NL-NL" xml:lang="NL-NL" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW92098321 BCX0">via the Education Route</span></span></span> or with secondary general adult education (VAVO). It's important that the level of the program is feasible for you. If so, you can explore how you can still reach this educational level. More information about VAVO can be found below. <span class="TrackChangeTextInsertion TrackedChange SCXW100771154 BCX0"><span class="TextRun SCXW100771154 BCX0" lang="NL-NL" xml:lang="NL-NL" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW100771154 BCX0">The Education Route w</span></span></span><span class="TrackChangeTextInsertion TrackedChange SCXW100771154 BCX0"><span class="TextRun SCXW100771154 BCX0" lang="NL-NL" xml:lang="NL-NL" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW100771154 BCX0">is offered by the municipality.</span></span></span></p></div>

					</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-7445" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="5" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-7445"><p>Do you have a residence permit 'asylum for a limited period'? Then you have to integrate. At various ROCs in the Netherlands you can combine your integration program with vocational training. </p><p class="gt-block"><strong>Combined routes   </strong></p><p>Are you combining your integration program with vocational training? Then you will learn Dutch better and you will also immediately learn a trade. You will follow a language course and an MBO course at entry level (MBO level 1). You do not need a diploma for this level. So no Dutch diploma and no diploma from your country of origin. If you successfully complete the process, you have passed your integration exam. You also have an MBO diploma that allows you to work. You can also continue your education and do an MBO course at a higher level.  </p><p class="gt-block"><strong>Admission requirements educational institutions  </strong></p><p>Conditions such as:  </p><ul data-gt-block="" class="gt-block"><li>You are over 16 years old.</li><li>You do not yet have a VMBO or higher level diploma in the Netherlands or in your country of origin.</li><li>Dutch is not your mother tongue.</li><li>Would you like to know more about the admission requirements? 									<div>
<h3><strong>Important: no new applications for study assistance without a residence permit</strong></h3>
<p>Are you still in the asylum procedure? If so, you cannot currently apply for study support from the UAF.</p>
<p>Until recently, this was possible. However, the UAF has a limited budget for this, and that money has run out. Therefore, we are currently no longer accepting new applications from people without a residence permit (people who already receive support from us will continue to receive that support).</p>
<p>We find this very unfortunate. The UAF is looking into possibilities to be able to offer this support again in the future. If the situation changes, you can find the updates on this page.</p>
<p class="gt-block">What is possible? You can use the for free. UAF Academy. This way you can already start working on your Dutch and your future. You will also find on <a href="https://www.uaf.nl/en/ondersteuning/ik-wil-advies/verblijfsvergunning/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">No residence permit (yet).</a> information about pursuing education during the asylum procedure.</p>
<p>Do you have a residence permit based on asylum? Then you can simply apply for support. Nothing changes in that regard.</p>
<h2> </h2>
<h2>When can the UAF help?</h2>
<p>Whether the UAF can help you depends on your personal situation.</p>
<p class="gt-block"><strong>Preparing to study in the Netherlands </strong><br>You can apply for support from the UAF if you meet these conditions:</p>
<ul data-gt-block="" class="gt-block">
<li style="font-size: 18px;">You live in the Netherlands.</li><li>You have a residence permit based on asylum. Without a residence permit, you cannot apply for support at this time.</li>
<li>You want to study at MBO level 3 or 4, HBO or university.</li>
<li>You have completed at least 10 years of education.</li>
<li>You started with or you speak Dutch at B1 level.</li>
</ul>
<p class="gt-block"><strong>Have you applied for asylum and is your application still being processed?</strong> <br>At this moment, we cannot (yet) support you with your studies. That is only possible once you have a residence permit. However, you can gain access to the UAF Academy. With the UAF Academy you can learn Dutch up to B1 level via self-study and take various online courses Ask <a href="https://www.uaf.nl/en/ondersteuning/ik-wil-studeren/uafacademy/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">access to the UAF Academy</a> on. To make use of the UAF Academy You need Dutch or English at least at A2 level.</p>
<p class="gt-block"><strong>Do you want to study in the Netherlands with support from the UAF? </strong><br>This is possible if you have at least a B1 level of Dutch proficiency (also for English-taught programs). You can receive study support from the UAF if you have a residence permit. </p>
<p class="gt-block"><strong>Have you already studied and do you want to start working right away? </strong><br>Often it is necessary that you follow a training or course to practice your profession in the Netherlands. Contact the UAF to discuss what you need.</p>
<p class="gt-block"><strong>How can you register?</strong><br>Please fill out the contact form below.</p>

((d, i, m) => {
  const ct = t => d.createTextNode(t);
  const ce = e => d.createElement(e);
        
  d.querySelectorAll(i).forEach(e => {

    const s = e.dataset.cookieblockSrc || e.src || '';
          
    const sp =
      /google\.com\/maps\/embed/.test(s) ? 'Google Maps' :
      /player\.vimeo\.com\/video\//.test(s) ? 'Vimeo' :
      /youtube(-nocookie)?\.com\/embed\//.test(s) ? 'YouTube' :
      undefined;

    if (!sp) return;

    const a = ce('a');
    const div = ce('div');
    const p = ce('p');

    div.innerHTML =
      `<div style="background-color:#CCC;display:inline-block;height:${e.height}px;position:relative;width:${e.width}px;">
        <div style="background-color:#848484;border-radius:15px;height:50%;position:absolute;transform:translate(50%,50%);width:50%;">
          <p style="color:#FFF;font-size:7.5em;position:relative;top:50%;left:50%;margin:0;text-align:center;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);">
            ···
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    div.classList.add(`cookieconsent-optout-${m}`);

    a.textContent = 'marketingcookies';
    a.href = 'javascript:Cookiebot.renew()';

    p.append(
      ct('Accepteer '),
      a,
      ct(` om deze ${sp}-video te bekijken.`)
    );

    div.append(p);

    const figure = e.closest('figure');
          
    if (sp === 'Vimeo' && figure) {
      figure.parentNode.insertBefore(div, figure);
    } else {
      e.parentNode.insertBefore(div, e);
    }
  });

})(document, 'iframe', 'marketing');
                
                
window.addEventListener('CookiebotOnAccept', updateState);
window.addEventListener('CookiebotOnDecline', updateState);
window.addEventListener('CookiebotOnLoad', updateState);


function updateState() {

    document.querySelectorAll('.cookieconsent-optout-marketing').forEach(el => {

        const figure = el.closest('figure');
        if (!figure) return;

        if (Cookiebot.consent?.marketing) {
            figure.classList.add('cookie-allowed');
            figure.classList.remove('cookie-blocked');
        } else {
            figure.classList.add('cookie-blocked');
            figure.classList.remove('cookie-allowed');
        }
    });
}

						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {
						document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
					} );
				} )();
